title: •Expand The Empire
caption: •Expand The Empire (V)
game_text: Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your aliens (except Mara), senators, Maul, and {independent} starships are lost. {alter}
lore: The Emperor disbanded the Imperial Senate “for the duration of the emergency,” seizing absolute power. He planned to extend rule by terrorizing planets into submission.

notes: Group: Imperial Senate (DARK SIDE). Unique. Bottom-half slip, banner EFFECT, no grabber box (grabber false). TALL SLIP: 6 text lines; the banner and text box sit higher than on a normal Effect slip (tall slip: banner higher by ~39 slip px — the banner sits at the same height under the heading as on Ultimatum #38, but the bottom border starts at y 443 instead of 404; crop 483 px tall vs 454). INLINE: 'and [icon] starships' = dark-blue square with a grey spoked wheel = the Independent icon → {independent} (the stub drops it: 'Maul, and starships'); red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub 'Immune to Alter.'). '>' as printed. Right of the text box: the black EPISODE I icon above the VS16 set sphere → icons ['episode1'] (Premiere card, no Episode I printed). LORE corrected from the scan: curly double quotes “for the duration of the emergency,” (wiki straight single quotes). Base Premiere-D-expandtheempire.gif 350 px only; copyright Premiere 1995 line by rule. Expansion per the wiki base page (|set=Premiere Limited). Modern: VB5-D-expandtheempire-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5 reissue). Stub: https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Expand_The_Empire_(V)_(Virtual_Set_16:_Revenge_Of_The_Sith)
